<ParamField body="descriptionPlacement" type="&quot;end&quot; | &quot;inline&quot;">

<ParamField body="disabled" type="boolean" default="false">

<ParamField body="endIcon" type="ReactNode">

<ParamField body="focusableWhenDisabled" type="boolean" default="false">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="focused" type="boolean">

<ParamField body="indicator" type="&quot;check&quot; | &quot;checkbox&quot; | &quot;none&quot;">
